errors.text_span: rises to about 23.7% at \(\alpha\approx0.5\), decreases to about 23.4% at \(\alpha=1\)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies a peak at alpha approximately 0.5. The plot shows a peak at alpha=1, with an accuracy of approximately 23.72%. The description mistakes the single peak point for two separate points.
The description gives an incorrect value for the data point at alpha=1. The plot shows the accuracy at alpha=1 is the peak value, approximately 23.72%, not 23.4%.

The description states the y-axis range starts at 'roughly 22.7%'. The axis labels clearly show the range starts at 22.75%. The value 22.7% is an approximation of the lowest data point, not the start of the axis range.
